title: Pipe chart playhead aligns with remarks
description:
The pipe chart playhead now follows the inspection's observation timecodes instead of assuming the camera moved at a constant speed. Clicking a remark places both the video and playhead on that remark's exact pipe line.

Who is affected: everyone using WinCan video remarks on the private server, and on SaaS after Push.
changeLog: Clicked remarks now align exactly with the pipe playhead.
The playhead interpolates smoothly between observation timecodes during playback.
